about: The wave table of the 2026-10-11 board run: each canvas node, the wave that closes it, its release, and the inventory items it owns. assign.mjs reads this table and the findings files and writes inventory.json; a re-cut is an edit here and a re-run. See canvas.md for the target state and plan.md for each wave's exit criteria.

waves.1: Integrate and make the gate trustworthy: land the incoming PRs, a hermetic gate, the finding classes as scripts, the board and registers telling the truth
waves.2: Delegation, spend and the operator session: the DEC-0037…0041 seam closed, one canonical-JSON register
waves.3: The organization edition's first contracts and activity/devices: fabric-package/1 first, then DEC-0030/0031 hardened and amended (CON-OE-01, CON-OE-12, run/result, v4 device fields, CT-25), estate-record/1 last
waves.4: Services on every system (with the v4 descriptor for listings), the operator channel and the embedded dashboard, and the agent network's transport (the relay, the delta and heartbeat, leases, signing challenges, device message signatures)
waves.6: The remaining organization-edition contracts and wave 4's follow-ups (closed 2026-10-12); contexts (N20) moved to the program

nodes.title: Land the incoming PRs: #32 (DEC-0041, the meter's grant read) after review fixes, then #31 (DEC-0042, session-handoff/1) rebased on it
A hermetic, self-checking gate: no foreign worktree in the test or lint scope; every positive fixture passes the semantic rules; a decision's affected paths resolve; rule branches covered
The board and the registers tell the truth: a row per canvas node and per consumer adoption, closed rows with receipts, the KB and wiki pointers current
Front-door documents true today: README status, acceptance evidence, navigation, the glossary, the source ledger's pinned revisions

Delegation and spend sealed: one refusal wire for the meter, one grant per token, the meter hop's depth, a strict verifier in DL-13's order, every security MUST killed by a test, the operator session's compatibility stated
One register of canonical forms: which bytes each signature or digest covers (settings-backup form, RFC 8785), with reference functions and shared test vectors

Runner and model profiles (CT-05, T2) on Fabric ADR-0147: the modelClasses vocabulary DEC-0037 left free, model and runner profiles, route subscription|key, headless drives, one resolution order, declared config slots, the profile's model allow-list on issued keys
Service hygiene asked by live consumers: `degraded[].setup` (CT-22), tools declared where they are used (LC-19, CT-23), no secret in a command line (LC-21, CT-24)
Activity and devices: rules killed by tests, the hashed-branch form unified, path-free details, the bound user checked, policy-key validity fixed, amended with CON-OE-01 and CON-OE-12
Services on macOS, Linux and Windows: CT-01 decided for every supervisor, the full lifecycle per system, Windows paths and token readers checked, superseded wording removed

The operator channel and the embedded dashboard: status invariants in the schema and killed by tests, the appearance cookie's scope, ED-6 against ED-9, an invalid declaration's handling, the UX scenario
The 0.1.0 core: claim and proof, learning approval separation, the product-manager rule, residue extensions, retention, standing-grant channels, contexts, A2A profile fields, rollback

Interop and usage: the job result, the provider rules after DEC-0017, the memory pilot's retirement, the comms status words, the usage report's window, CON-OE-13 and the OpenRouter attribution headers

The open organization-edition contracts: proposals (CON-OE-05), surfaces.a2a well-known part (CON-OE-06), versions N and N-1 (CON-OE-07), the session join key (CON-OE-08), the local channel (CON-OE-10), then the node manifest, package and agent profile (CON-OE-03) in parts
Carried to the program: work whose inputs another owner has not produced yet
items: PRIVATE (out of scope for this repository)

nodes.title: Consumer adoption: each consumer adopts by its own release and pin (DEC-0016); tracked on the board as CT-03, CT-04 and CT-18…CT-21
The organization edition's first contracts (v4 D4): fabric-package/1 (format and digest; signatures) with agentRef, then estate-record/1

The agent network's transport: the relay and the secret envelope, the revocation delta and heartbeat, window leases, signing challenges, and HTTP message signatures for devices behind a TLS-terminating host
Wave 4's follow-ups: the owed readings of DEC-0054/0062/0063, the relay audit's consolidated revision, the agent-sync id defect (re-cut to wave 6 on 2026-10-12: each waits on an outside event)

Contexts (RM-28): the contract's part of the organization-contexts model (CX-CON-01…10), a node summary and headless enrollment token (DV-CON-01, answered "amend" 2026-10-12) and workflow cells under FAC-SEM-067 (moved to the program on 2026-10-12: each waits on Fabric's organization ADR, D8, or its workflow fixed-executor field, CX-FAB-05)
